summary: Deuteronomy identifies Sirion as the Sidonian name for Hermon. Psalm 29 pairs Sirion with Lebanon and pictures the mountains leaping at Yahweh’s voice.

senses.definition: Sirion is the Sidonian name of Hermon, which leaps at Yahweh’s voice.

note: The geographical name has no final tet. The incision words indexed nearby belong to שׂרט. Deuteronomy 3:9 distinguishes Sirion from the Amorite name Senir.
